title: Step 9b does not dispatch mapped unsupported image alt repairs
steps: Run the step 9b capability behavioral tests with fake site-agent turns and real repair scheduling.
expect: Known unsupported mapped image alts open no native sessions and remain blocking with an explicit reason.
Supported article, module HTML and gallery alt repairs still dispatch.
Missing, unmatched and incomplete content maps retain the previous repair path.
New unsupported alts exposed by recovery are recorded without a paid retry.
fence: This change schedules existing supported doors only; it does not change QA acceptance, write through another door or assert customer consent.

tests: mapped contact image alt stays blocking without opening or repeating a native turn
supported article and module HTML alt storage still receives native repairs
gallery alt slots preserve block to module aliases even when picture storage has no record alt
absent or unmatched content maps retain the existing native repair path
a supported independent fault still runs while unsupported contact alt remains red
direct unsupported comment metadata never claims the alt target is writable
unsupported alts exposed after page recovery are recorded without a paid retry
runStepNine carries the write content map into unsupported alt scheduling and preserves failed handover
